name: Motoswap
reason: Motoswap (MOTO) is the protocol token of Motoswap, a DEX on Ethereum (site https://motoswap.org). Contract 0xBd965230588EAA536dE6aA45E8ebbc01638535e0, 18 decimals, fixed supply 10,000,000,000, no owner role, no mint, no pause, no upgrade; verified on Etherscan and a full match on Sourcify. Deployed 2026-09-14. Liquidity on Ethereum mainnet: Uniswap V2 MOTO/WETH pair 0xAD1a21F61d653c6101b92c335f61140459C81C79 (about 120 ETH deep on launch day), plus MOTO/USDT 0x9723985b1269bf7600e82cc20a5338951bf413e5 and USDC/MOTO 0x7e07e520f05c7d510aebc36b4ac942255b7c5723. DexScreener: https://dexscreener.com/ethereum/0xad1a21f61d653c6101b92c335f61140459c81c79. Uniswap default-token-list request: https://github.com/Uniswap/default-token-list/issues/2578. DefiLlama adapter PR: https://github.com/DefiLlama/DefiLlama-Adapters/pull/21035. Filed by the project team; contact support@motoswap.org. An earlier CLI-filed copy of this request (issue #1506) lacked the addToken label; this web-form issue supersedes it.
